question: Alaska uses ranked-choice voting. Suppose that in the final round of the US Senate election on 3 November 2026, only two candidates are left: Dan S. Sullivan (Republican) and Mary Peltola (Democrat). In past elections, some people found it hard to make up their minds, and some of them decided not to vote at all. If you can't choose between them, say "Undecided". If you probably won't vote, say "Would not vote". Otherwise, which of the two would you vote for?
